Dear Dana Whitfield,

Thank you for the discovery conversation of 6 October 2026. Tamarack Instruments has deployed a customer service chatbot on its support portal. It is piloting AI visual inspection on the German production line and plans to introduce AI sales forecasting next year. Your objective is to have governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027. That deadline matters more because the June 2026 internal audit found no inventory of AI systems. The Executive Briefing would give your leadership group a shared view of what the EU AI Act and GDPR are likely to expect of each use case. We present these as expectations to verify with counsel, not as legal advice. For the chatbot, we would cover transparency toward customers and personal data handling consistent with your requirement that customer data stay in the EU. For visual inspection, we would examine whether the system could fall into a higher risk category under the EU AI Act. We would also consider how German works council consultation fits the Q2 2027 timeline. United States requirements are not among your stated drivers, so we would cover them only as a general landscape item.

We would then outline a governance operating model using the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). We would show how it can sit alongside your existing ISO management systems and agree implementation priorities, beginning with the AI inventory. Board reporting would draw on AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). Throughout, we apply three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human.

The Briefing runs for two hours, live and virtual, at a price of US$3,000. It is designed for your attendee group: yourself, the CISO, the Head of Quality, the Head of Data, the German plant manager and two internal auditors. The fee sits within the US$80,000 budget approved for this fiscal year.

After the session, the Client receives a summary memo.
